<thought>The spectrum shows a classic carbon isotopic pattern: a dominant M peak, an M+1 peak at ~14% intensity (consistent with ~13 carbons), and progressively smaller M+2, M+3, etc., matching the binomial distribution of 13C. No large M+2 peaks characteristic of Cl, Br, or S are present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
